_**Agent (claude-fable-5 2026-07-06 17:48:28Z)**_

**No — there's no `specstory skills pull` command on any branch.** The closest work is on the `skills-interface` branch (both local and `origin/skills-interface`), which adds a full `specstory skills` command group to specstory-cli, but its subcommands are:

`list`, `show <name>`, `install <name>`, `reinstall <name>`, `uninstall <name>`, `approve <name>`, `reject <name>`, `status`, `run`, `runs`, and `agents` — defined in `specstory-cli/pkg/cmd/skills.go` on that branch, with supporting code in `specstory-cli/pkg/skills/` (engine, install, lock, agents) and `specstory-cli/pkg/cloud/skills.go`.

So the "fetch a skill from the cloud" concept exists, but it's spelled `skills install` (browse/approve/install cloud skills, per commit `4a55fc0`), not `pull`. I grepped all branches for "skills pull" and the only hits were incidental text in `.specstory/history` session files, not code or docs. If you're planning a `pull` (e.g., re-sync installed skills to latest), it would be new work — likely a natural extension of the existing install/lock machinery on `skills-interface`.

_**Agent (claude-fable-5 2026-07-07 15:25:07Z)**_

It's:

```
specstory skills install <name>
```

That's the `pull` equivalent — it fetches a ready (approved) skill from SpecStory Cloud and installs it into your agent harnesses ([skills.go:166](specstory-cli/pkg/cmd/skills.go:166), "Install a ready skill into your agents"). Related companions: `specstory skills reinstall <name>` to re-pull/refresh one that's already installed, and `specstory skills list` to browse what's available in the cloud library first.
